subroutines.name: basic_print_string
subroutines.title: Print the zero-terminated string at A/Y

subroutines.name: kernal_irq_handler
subroutines.title: The Kernal's IRQ handler (updates the clock, flashes the cursor and scans the keyboard, then returns from the interrupt)

subroutines.name: setmsg
subroutines.title: Set which Kernal messages are shown (bit 7: control messages, bit 6: error messages)

subroutines.name: setlfs
subroutines.title: Set the logical file number, device number and secondary address

subroutines.name: open
subroutines.title: Open a logical file (set up with SETLFS and SETNAM)

subroutines.name: clrchn
subroutines.title: Restore the default input and output channels

subroutines.name: chrin
subroutines.title: Read a character from the input channel

subroutines.name: load
subroutines.title: Load or verify a file (set up with SETLFS and SETNAM)

on_entry.x: load address if the secondary address is 0 (low byte)
on_entry.y: load address if the secondary address is 0 (high byte)

on_exit.x: end address of the data loaded (low byte)
on_exit.y: end address of the data loaded (high byte)

subroutines.name: save
subroutines.title: Save memory to a file (set up with SETLFS and SETNAM)

on_entry.a: zero page address of the start address

subroutines.name: getin
subroutines.title: Get a character from the input channel (from the keyboard, 0 if there's none)

subroutines.name: plot
subroutines.title: Read or set the cursor position (carry set: read it into X/Y; carry clear: set it from X/Y)
